description: This file defines functions to generate dashboard chart configurations for an ERP system, including retrieving company info, default dashboards, and account details.

methods.name: get_company_for_dashboards
methods.description: Retrieves the current company for dashboards, defaulting to the first in the list if not set.

methods.name: get_default_dashboards
methods.description: Generates a dictionary with dashboard configurations, including charts and their data sources.

methods.name: get_account
methods.description: Fetches the account name for a given account type and company.
